The required 22/25 score, accepted score arithmetic, candidate traversal, first-best ties, perfect-score termination and false-return zero coordinates remain unchanged. Existing recognition allowances, format hints, oracles and payload scoring are unchanged.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 219/267 correct positive images versus 219/267 previously; gained: none; previously correct positive images lost: none. Paired negative completion is [26, 30, 28, 29]/31 currently and [25, 23, 30, 30]/31 previously. QR alignment scoring skips candidates that cannot meet the unchanged acceptance threshold. Available search work inside the original allowance can change bounded recognition and completion; the private kernel decision diagnostic does not establish unbounded accuracy gains. Paired nineteen-image costs and nine-request retail costs remain separate, with every sample and recognition failure retained. No recognition allowance, hint, oracle or scoring change. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by this remediation, not an unseen holdout. Invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracles and undeclared QR encoding policies remain unchanged. Shared-host contention and budgets affect results. Stacked DataBar/Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported. These finite workloads do not establish overall superiority.
